title: Known-object test, TOI-3246.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-3246.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 3.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 2% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit gap, not recovered, partial, recovered (6 covered epochs). Residual screen: 0 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 1 light curve(s).
